definitions.explanation: Designed for or intended for use in the home, as opposed to commercial, industrial, or professional use. A very common modifier on product labels, advertisements, and in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Home video game consoles are popular.

examples.japanese: これは{家庭用|かていよう}の{洗剤|せんざい}です。
{業務用|ぎょうむよう}と{家庭用|かていよう}では{容量|ようりょう}も{価格|かかく}も{大|おお}きく{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The capacity and price are vastly different between commercial and household products.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a pre-noun modifier with の or directly before a noun. Part of a productive pattern: {家庭用|かていよう} (household), {業務用|ぎょうむよう} (commercial), {工業用|こうぎょうよう} (industrial). Extremely common on product packaging and in stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き} (home game console)
- {家庭用|かていよう}{洗剤|せんざい} (household detergent)
- {家庭用|かていよう}{電気|でんき}{製品|せいひん} (household electrical appliances)
- {家庭用|かていよう}{蓄電池|ちくでんち} (home storage battery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}: for commercial/business use — larger quantities, professional grade
- {個人用|こじんよう}: for personal use — focuses on individual rather than household
